title: postlaunch-probechain: API + KV-cache + model-load validation for private deployments
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Goal: implement a deterministic post-launch probe chain (ProbeChain) that runs automatically after Terraform apply for Private/VPC deployments. ProbeChain should validate API readiness, confirm model artifact loading (including quantized and fp16 variants), exercise KV-cache cold->warm transitions, and run a short synthetic load profile to validate latency SLOs before marking a deployment 'ready'. This ticket covers the automation, thresholds, telemetry exports, and follow-up remediation hooks.
acceptance_criteria: ProbeChain runs as a final step in the deploy pipeline (terraform -> apply -> trigger) and returns a single success/failure artifact to the deployment state machine.
API readiness checks: public control-plane and tenant API endpoints respond 200 to /health and /v1/models within 5s and 10s respectively for 5 consecutive probes.

Model load checks: small model (7B) and large model (70B) variants load end-to-end with KV cache warmup; first-token latency for loaded models must be < 1200ms for small and < 4500ms for large in our private clusters under baseline conditions.
KV-cache validation: confirm cache hits increase after sequential prefix calls and that cached-responses reduce token latency by at least 30% compared to cold calls.

Synthetic load smoke: run a 30s burst at target concurrency (5 for small models, 2 for large) and ensure >= 95% of tokens served under configured latency SLOs (200ms p50, 600ms p95 for small models on dedicated GPU pools).
Failure modes are recorded to a DeployFailure artifact with links to logs, GPU metrics, and PRs; automatic rollback is NOT performed by ProbeChain (explicit operator action required).
Documentation (console runbook) and a GitHub Actions job exist to reproduce the ProbeChain locally for debug.
test_plan: Integrate ProbeChain into the existing deploy pipeline: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra-deploy/pull/842
Create a lightweight harness in staging that uses a known model bundle (test-7b-v1) and a large-replica variant (test-70b-quant) to exercise both paths.
Measure and capture metrics to the deployment metrics dashboard (grafana link) and a one-off snapshot exported to S3 for triage.
Include negative tests: corrupt model artifact, limited GPU memory, and network egress blocked to validate clear failure artifacts.
runbook: How to trigger: terraform apply -> CI pipeline step 'postdeploy-probechain' runs automatically. To re-run manually: ./scripts/run_probechain.sh --env staging --bundle test-7b-v1
Where to look on failure: DeployFailure artifact in S3 (s3://redwood-deployments/{deployment_id}/probechain/failure.json) and logs at https://logs.redwood.internal/deploy/{deployment_id}

Immediate remediation checklist: 1) Check node-level GPU OOMs, 2) Verify model artifact SHA and unmarshalling errors, 3) Inspect networking rules (NAT, egress), 4) Re-run probechain with --debug and upload snapshot to #infra-deploy for triage.
Escalation: If ProbeChain fails in >2 consecutive deploys for the same cluster, tag oncall-sre and open INC-xxxxx. Include deployment id and failure artifact link.
progress_updates: 2026-02-11: Spike completed. Validated manual sequence for API health -> model load -> kv-cache warmup on a single dev node. Noted that large model cold-starts can exceed 3 minutes on older drivers.
2026-02-18: Prototype script merged to feature branch. Added early telemetry emit for first-byte and first-token latency. PR: infra-deploy/pull/842

2026-02-25: Design review with Platform (Olivia Chen) and SRE (Diego Morales). Decision: ProbeChain will not auto-rollback; it will create a DeployFailure artifact and surface in Console. Added requirement to capture GPU driver versions in success/failure payload.
2026-03-03: Implemented kv-cache correctness probe. Observed inconsistent hit rates when batch-size heuristic was 2; adjusted logic to run prefix-length 6 warmup sequence. Patch in PR 862.

2026-03-08: Load smoke harness added (lib/probe/sim_client). Running nightly against staging cluster (staging-probe-001) to collect baseline percentiles. Noted p95 drift for small models during noisy neighbor test - filed ENG-41399.
2026-03-12: Integration tests green in CI; awaiting security review for KMS access used by model artifact fetcher. Assigned to Security (Maya Patel) for review.
